MR-I READYFEMUR

Set the legs up with flexible arrays from hip to knee, run the 3-plane localiser, plan the axial square to the femur from above the femoral head to below the knee — then angle the coronal and sagittal on it
Demonstration only — an educational simulation of MRI planning, not a medical device, not for clinical use. Every diagnostic image is reformatted from one real 3D MRI of a healthy volunteer's leg (public-domain research data), shown with its true geometry; the localiser is rebuilt from the same volumes — see the credits on the results screen.
